solver: Reused NCA D2Q9 BGK, halfway bounce-back, momentum-exchange force; Torch float64 CPU/CUDA

geometry.mapping: Union of triangle projections onto sagittal x-z plane, then length/thickness scaling and nose-up pitch. Mesh x runs snout-to-tail. Treat projected silhouette as infinite spanwise extrusion, not a 3D aerodynamic body.
geometry.print_changes: Source mesh has print-thickened fins, rounded features and display scale; not specimen geometry

domain.boundaries: Left/top/bottom reset to uniform equilibrium rho1,u=U,v=0. Right zero-gradient population outflow. Rigid no-slip halfway bounce-back on triangle-derived mask.
domain.initial_condition: Uniform flow outside body; solid populations held at rest equilibrium. Start-up transient retained.

controls.analytic_prerequisite: Rerun original NCA Poiseuille H16/32/64 and Taylor-Green N32/64/128, exact original criteria, including closed-case mass drift. All must pass before fish-flow artifact generation.

stability.failure_policy: Stop this configuration immediately; no video from a failing stable-domain run

drag_sign.case: baseline fish after final20percent transient window
drag_sign.criterion: mean drag coefficient >0; opposite force-sign mutant must fail

time_pair.meaning: Halve physical timestep at fixed dx, physical Re and exact convective end time; collision viscosity changes consistently

grid_pair.meaning: Refine both lattice spacing and mapped timestep at fixed physical Re/domain and equal end time; staircase geometry changes recorded

controls.label: PASS only if analytic/no-body/stability/drag-sign/grid/time/flux checks pass. PARTIAL for finite stable flow whose grid/time/flux check fails; display exact failures and no calibrated coefficient claim. FAIL for prerequisite/stability/sign failure. Preserve all outcomes; never change bounds after seeing runs.

not_established: 3D finite-span flow, lift or flight Reynolds numbers
measured fish polar or physical validation
fluid-structure feedback, flexible fins or active propulsion
pitch/heave actuation: interface proposal only; rigid static mask in this run

inputs_proposed.name: pitch_rad
inputs_proposed.status: static AoA supported; dynamic pitching not implemented

runtime.gpu: Only GPUops may dispatch a pinned same-code CUDA refinement after CPU controls; no arbitrary occupancy workload
